title: Xivilelo Lexi Twiweke Ehenhla Ka Mpfumawulo
intro: U twa rito ri tlakuka ri huma eka rixaka leri ku tshikileriwa ku hundzukeke ntolovelo. Ku hava ku kombisiwa ka matimba loku hlamulaka xivilelo; ematshan’weni ya sweswo, xikombelo lexi kongomeke xi fika eka Allah, naswona nhlamulo yi hlasela embilwini ya vugandzeri hi byoxe. I mani loyi a endleke xivilelo xexo, i xivutiso xihi lexi landzeleke naswona i ntiyiso wihi lowu tiyisiweke?
clues: Ndzi sungule ku karhatiwa hi ku tshikileriwa hi vanhu lava a va ri ekusuhi na mina.
Ndzi phofule xivilelo xexo hi ku kongoma eka Allah hi xivilelo xa munhu hi xiyexe.
Allah u twe xivilelo kutani a hlamula hi ntlhontlho mayelana ni ripfumelo ra mina.
Nhlamulo yi vutisile leswaku ndzi nga tsandzeka njhani ku pfumela eka Allah, loyi a nga Un’we ni Loyi a Tlakukeke.
Kutani ndzi vutisile leswaku ha yini Allah a fanele a tsakela vanhu lava nga pfumeriki.
Mina ndzi Uzair, loyi a boxiweke eka Surah Az-Zukhruf tanihi loyi xivilelo xa yena Allah a xi tweke.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Uzair
Munghana loyi a fambeke hi xikepe ehenhla ka ndhambi leyikulu
Nandza loyi a a famba ehenhla ka mati
Loyi a etleleke u sirhelele endzeni ka bako
Nandza loyi a tiseke maribye enambyeni

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku vilela eka Allah hi ku tshikileriwa ka vanhu
Ku famba ehenhla ka mati hi nkarhi wa xidzedze
Ku rhwala maribye enambyeni lowu a wu pfumala mati
Ku famba hi xikepe exikarhi ka ndhambi leyikulu hi xikepe xa Areka
Ku amukela xilotlelo xa rifuwo lerikulu swinene
trial.answer: Ku vilela eka Allah hi ku tshikileriwa ka vanhu

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Xivilelo lexi kongomeke lexi kongomisiweke eka Allah
Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Furnice yi endle leswaku ku va ni ku kufumela ni ku rhula
Ngalava leyi papamalaka ehenhla ka mati ya ndhambi
Nhlampfi yi mita nandza
location.answer: Xivilelo lexi kongomeke lexi kongomisiweke eka Allah

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Allah u twe xivilelo kutani a tiyisekisa Vun’we bya Xikwembu ni Vuhosi lebyi Tlakukeke
Ku famba u hlayisekile ematini hi nkarhi wa xidzedze
Ku tsemakanya ndhambi leyikulu hi ku hlayiseka hi khandziya Areka
Ku tlhela u vona endzeni ka xigodlho xa ku tikukumuxa
Ku amukela vulawuri lebyi sukelaka eVuxeni ku ya eVupela-dyambu
outcome.answer: Allah u twe xivilelo kutani a tiyisekisa Vun’we bya Xikwembu ni Vuhosi lebyi Tlakukeke

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
